test_title: SSC CHSL 2025 Tier-1 (Held On: 21 Nov, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Choose the most suitable option to replace the highlighted part of the sentence :

The **__dessert__ **is a dry piece of land.
solution:
The correct answer is '1' i.e. desert .

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• In the given sentence, the word "dessert" is mistakenly used in place of "desert".
